# Triangle 1.6

Unmodified `triangle.c`, `triangle.h` and `README` from
https://www.netlib.org/voronoi/triangle.zip (July 28, 2005 release).
Author: Jonathan Richard Shewchuk. Documentation: https://www.cs.cmu.edu/~quake/triangle.html.

Original copyright and redistribution terms are retained in the source header.
Private, research and institutional use is free; commercial redistribution requires
an arrangement with the author. Triangle is not covered by this project’s license.

Built as a native C library with TRILIBRARY and ANSI_DECLARATORS, double precision,
and no fast-math. The application uses `pzQ` (the Python wrapper adds `z` to `pQ`).
No Python runtime is required.
